# Prybambas

> Free STEM education hub for curious kids ages 5–14, plus free tools for parents of little ones 0–4. No login required.

## What it is

Prybambas (https://prybambas.com) is a free web app and PWA with these spaces:

- **What If?** — logic and cause-and-effect game for kids. Modes: single round, logic chain, deduction.
- **Inventor Lab** — TRIZ-inspired creative thinking: tools, 30-day calendar, challenges, missions (Rookie / Agent / Elite).
- **AI Coach** — language practice companion (links to coach-ai hub).
- **For the Littlest** (Наймолодшим) — tools for parents of babies and toddlers 0–4. First tool: the **100 First Foods & Allergen Tracker**, a free baby-led weaning / solid food tracker with daily plate ideas (protein, complex carb, veggie, fruit), a 3-day allergen rhythm (introduce, a day with no new foods, repeat), a reaction log, a weekly summary and a printable doctor report. No account; data stays on the parent's device or in their own family file; works offline.

## Who it's for

- Children ages 5–14
- Parents of babies and toddlers 0–4 (For the Littlest)
- Parents, homeschoolers, teachers
- Multilingual families (11+ languages)

## Languages

English, Ukrainian, Polish, Spanish, German, French, Romanian, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, and more.
